reviews.title: Still My Favorite Podcast App, But Losing Confidence
reviews.text:
I've been using Downcast for practically as long as I've owned an iPhone, and I've always considered it the best podcast app available. I've tried several alternatives over the years, but none come close to its features, flexibility, and organization.

Unfortunately, the app has become increasingly unstable, particularly on my iPhone 17 running iOS 27.0.1. It's disappointing that the last update was about a year ago. I wish the developer would release updates more regularly, especially in anticipation of new iOS releases, to ensure continued compatibility and reliability.

I genuinely love this app and would much rather see it improved than move on. But without meaningful updates and stability improvements, I may finally have to consider an alternative. It's disappointing to see such a great app fall behind. I hope the developer hasn’t forgotten about it.

reviews.title: Please recompile!
reviews.text:
I have been using Downcast for 15+ years. It has always been a perfect podcast player with all the functionality I need.
However, over the past few years—and especially since upgrading to iOS 27—it has started crashing more and more often, particularly when managing playlists.
Dear developer, please consider a recompilation of the app. I would even be willing to pay for the app again if that would help bring it back to the level of stability it once had.
Thank you for keeping Downcast available!

reviews.title: URLs not resolving
reviews.text: All of a sudden all my urls stopped resolving. Everything is stuck in the download queue.

reviews.title: Was Good Now Meh
reviews.text:
when I first downloaded it, it was the best option. It had a number of features, including speed control. Since it was downloaded, the quality has been lacking. Increasing freezes, skipping during playback, jumping to other podcasts, disappearing playlists, inability to export podcasts, and so many more problems.

There have been no updates at all in almost 18 months. I have to wonder if it’s finally been abandoned.

reviews.title: Where are all my playlists.
reviews.text: Updated after it crashed and had to upload again.  Now ALL my podcasts lists have been deleted.  So bad update bad mananger.

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: No way to import files from other podcast apps. It’s a bare bones podcast app that hasn’t had any updates or bug fixes in over a month.

reviews.title: Doesn’t seem supported anymore
reviews.text: The watch app hasn’t worked properly in a month or more. No updates in that timeframe. Time to find a new podcast app.

reviews.title: Better But Not Great
reviews.text: Looking for an alternative to Apple Podcast. This app brings back some functionality that Apple has lost touch with, but was hoping for more podcast playlist settings abilities. Trying a different app now, but maybe the good days of podcasts are over.

reviews.title: Buggy, slow, no development
reviews.text: I’ve loved this app for over a decade but the current developer has other things to do I guess.  Deleting a podcast episode often doesn’t work.  Schedule WiFi updates of new episodes just doesn’t happen. Maybe a CarPlay widget could be created? All ideas that someone putting time into this would work on.

reviews.title: Not so good anymore
reviews.text: This use to be a good app. Lately however none of my podcasts play through to the end. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Auto skipped to the end of a series…
reviews.text:
Just downloaded. It blows my mind that Apple Podcasts can’t do the most simple thing in the world - pick up on the last thing I was listening to. I did a search for an alternative and Downcast was the top contender. I just had my first listening experience and WTF !?! I started with the first episode of a 10 episode series. After the first episode it skipped ahead to the 10th. After some confusion and spoilers, I looked at my phone and figured it out.

Dear podcast player developers- The first offering should be the last episode you were listening to and the default should be playing episodes in order.
